hooks.command:
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(java|xml|gradle)$' || exit 0; content=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null | head -100); jq -n --arg f "$f" --arg c "$content" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":("CODE REVIEW for \($f):
Please review this file for bugs, code quality issues, and improvements (3-5 bullet points):
```
\($c)
```")}}'; } 2>/dev/null || true
